newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Arafat willing to meet Netanyahu - aide.
newsitem.headline: Arafat willing to meet Netanyahu - aide.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat is willing to meet Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu provided they discuss ending a crisis over Israeli settlement policy, an Arafat aide said on Thursday.

"The president is willing to meet Netanyahu if the meeting is to discuss the latest Israeli measures, including the settlement in (Arab East Jerusalem) and (West Bank) redeployment," Marwan Kanafani told Reuters.
Kanafani's statement came amid Israeli-Arab tensions heightened by the killing of seven Israeli schoolgirls by a Jordanian soldier on the Israel-Jordan border.

Arafat, angry over Israel's plans to build 6,500 more homes for Jews in Arab East Jerusalem and a West Bank pullback proposal that fell far short of what the PLO had demanded, has been refuing to take phone calls from Netanyahu.
Kanafani said the meeting must be aimed specifically at resolving the settlement issue and the scope of the first of three West Bank pullbacks which Israel is committed to complete by mid-1998.
There was no immediate comment from Netanyahu's office. Arafat willing to meet Netanyahu - aide
